Yamato: "...Maybe she's asleep...
Shall we come back later?"
Touya: "Yeah, let's do that."
Ai: "Oh."
Touya: "Hey."
Ai: "Well, well..."
Touya: "Huh?"
Ai: "Well, I'll let it go this time.
Leone's inside. See you."
Touya: "What's with her?"
Yamato: "I wonder what Ai was doing."
Go after Ai.
Visit Leone.
Yamato: "Oh, Touya!"
Touya: "Hey, Ai!"
Ai: "Huh? Weren't you here to see Leone?"
Touya: "That's not really why I came."
Ai: "Oh? Then were you here to see me?"
That's right.
W-What are you talking about...?
Ai: "Huh...? R-Really...?"
Touya: "Why would I lie about something like that?
That's why I came after you."
Ai: "Hee hee hee. I'm so happy."
Yamato: "Say, Ai, did you go to Leone's room
because you were worried about her?"
Ai: "Huh? Y-Yeah, well...
We'd more or less sorted things out, but she still looked uneasy,
so I was a little worried."
Touya: "You're surprisingly thoughtful."
Ai: "You can leave out the 'surprisingly.'
<FC:1E:3E><FC:84:3C:1C:F0>...Anyway, I went over, but it seems everyone had the same idea."
Touya: "What do you mean?"
Ai: "It looks like everyone had already dropped by
when I got there. Leone was really happy."
Touya: "I see... Hm? Does that mean I'm the only one
who hasn't been to see Leone?"
Ai: "...That's how it looks."
Touya: "...Well, I don't think she'd sulk
over something like that..."
Ai: "No. You go and see her properly.
She's pretty sensitive, you know."
Touya: "Hmm..."
Ai: "Go on, get going!"
Touya: "A-All right. See you."
Ai: "Yeah, bye."
Ai: "Ha ha ha! Oh, I was only joking.
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:04><FC:01:3E><FC:04:3C:16:F0>Why are you getting so flustered?"
Touya: "You..."
Ai: "Still, I'm glad you didn't flat-out deny it."
Touya: "If I felt that way, I wouldn't have come after you."
Ai: "That's true."
Yamato: "Say, Ai, did you go to Leone's room

Ai: "Huh? Y-Yeah, well...
<FC:1E:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:02><FC:02:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:03><FC:03:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:07>We'd more or less sorted things out, but she still looked uneasy,

Touya: "Hmm..."
Ai: "Go on, get going!"
Touya: "A-All right. See you."
Ai: "Yeah, bye."
Leone: "Coming!"
Touya: "Uh, it's me. Got a minute?"
Leone: "Oh... Y-Yeah, of course."
Leone: "What brings you here?"
Touya: "Looks like Ai was here just now..."
Leone: "Huh? Oh, yeah. She was.
Not just Ai. Everyone came to see me."
Yamato: "Huh? So we're the last ones?"
Leone: "Yeah. But I'm glad you came. Thank you.
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:03>And everyone even kept my room for me..."
Touya: "Well, whatever else you might say, everyone's
a good person, really."
Leone: "Yeah."
Yamato: "I'm glad it worked out."
Leone: "Yeah. That's why I have to do my best.
For everyone who believed in me, too."
Touya: "I don't think you need to be so stiff about it.
You don't have to push yourself too hard, either.
Why not follow the path you believe in?"
Leone: "The path I believe in...?"
Touya: "Yeah. Not that I'm in any position to lecture you,
but first you think about what you ought to do,
then you think about what you can do."
Leone: "...That sounds kind of difficult."
Touya: "I think so too."
Yamato: "It's easy enough to say, isn't it?"
Leone: "I'll... do my best.
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:16:0A><FC:03:3E><FC:04:3C:16:09><FC:02:3E><FC:04:3C:16:F2>From now on, I'll think things through for myself."
Touya: "Yeah."
Leone: "Touya... If I start losing my way,
will you help me again?"
Touya: "Huh?"
Leone: "Can I... put my trust in you?"
Of course.
Well, that's a bit...
Leone: "...I'm glad.
Hearing you say that makes me feel braver somehow."
Touya: "You're making too much of it."
Leone: "No. It's really important to me.
<FC:3C:3E><FC:84:3C:FF:02>I feel bad for everyone else, but having you come
made me happiest of all..."
Touya: "I-I see..."
Leone: "..."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "A-Ahem!"
Leone: "Oh! Ha ha, ha ha ha...
C-Come and see me again anytime."
Touya: "Y-Yeah... See you, then."
Leone: "Yeah."
Yamato: "...Have you really thought about Melvi?
Don't blame me for whatever happens."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "...Have you really thought about Ai?
Don't blame me for whatever happens."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "...Have you really thought about Kasumi?
Don't blame me for whatever happens."
Touya: "..."
Kasumi: "Touya."
Yamato: "...Have you really thought about Aurelie?
Don't blame me for whatever happens."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "...Have you really thought about Celica?
Don't blame me for whatever happens."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "...Have you really thought about Melissa?
Don't blame me for whatever happens."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Being kind to everyone is one of your good points, Touya,
but it has its downsides too."
Touya: "Huh?"
Yamato: "Never mind. Just make sure you really
think about Leone."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Leone: "O-Okay...
<FC:1E:3E><FC:04:3C:16:10><FC:02:3E><FC:04:3C:16:11><FC:03:3E><FC:04:3C:16:13>S-Sorry I said something so strange.
Ha ha ha ha. Forget about it."
Touya: "It's not that I dislike you or anything."
Leone: "Yeah, I know. I was just trying to force
my own feelings on you...
Touya: "..."
Leone: "...Well, then. I guess I'll
clean my room."
Touya: "O-Okay. I'll be going, then..."
Leone: "Yeah. See you."
Yamato: "...Well, I can understand,
but that may have been a little hard on her."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. That's unusual.
I wonder if someone's inside."
Touya: "Well, people do use it."
Yamato: "But it's always stopped whenever I see it.
And it's right on the floor I'm on."
Touya: "You're imagining it. You're imagining it. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
To protect those I love, my blade of justice strikes the enemy!
My crimson blood burns red! Such is the way a man must live!
A man of justice and truth!
Faaain, Jiiin, Baaaariooon!!
I have arrived! For justice... I would die!"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Heeey!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I went to all the trouble of waiting for you..."
Touya: "...You should get Gabon to take a look at you."
Fain: "What?! I'm the very picture of health!
I'm not so feeble that I'd fall ill!
Bwa ha ha ha ha!"
Yamato: "...It's serious."
Fain: "...So, how was it? I'm pretty confident
about this one. Ah, my own talent frightens me."
It was pretty good.
It sounded like enka.
Fain: "Right? Especially the last part. Even I got chills
saying it!"
Yamato: "He's drunk on himself... It's terminal."
Touya: "R-Right. Well, keep at it."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm... You could call it 'the song
of the Japanese heart,' I guess."
Fain: "The heart? So you mean a song that speaks
directly to the soul?"
Yamato: "W-Well, something like that."
Fain: "Oh! Then that means my introduction
is just as magnificent!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Bwa ha ha ha ha! You understand!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, how come you're always
so single-minded?"
Fain: "Heh heh heh... Because I believe in justice!
To die for it would be my greatest wish!
And that justice also protects those dear to me!"
Touya: "Huh. Those dear to you, eh...?"
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, and for Ymir,
and for K-Kasumi... No! My justice is not so
fickle! Oh, what am I supposed to do...?"
Yamato: "...What do we do?"
Touya: "We'd better keep our distance..."
Fain: "Come on, we're friends!
Tell me, who should I fight for?
I have vowed in my heart to love just one woman.
Yet I also have the noble and supreme
duty of protecting the princess. I can abandon neither loyalty nor love.
Ah... What a trial! Such is the fate of a knight!
Then I shall press onward! To battle my destiny!
No, wait. My master also said that to desire too much at once
is the same as losing it all.
Does that mean I must commit myself to just one?!
Oh! How can this be?!
And to choose between Ymir and Kasumi...
Grr... This is all because of those fiends from ≪Ze=Ode≫...
If it weren't for them, I would never have had
to suffer like thiiis...
Wait! Could this be a conspiracy of theirs?!
Grrrrrr... Damn them... How vile...
No, what a fearsome foe is ≪Ze=Ode≫!!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, will not be discouraged
by such a trifle! Hm? Does that mean
that to turn their plan against them, I must preserve my love for both women
and my loyalty to the princess,
all at the same time?
No, but then I'd be defying my master's teachings.
Aaaaah, what am I supposed to doooo?!!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Yamato: "...He has his troubles too."
Touya: "Well, he seems happy enough with the way he is.
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
